- Mandatory: Order of finalize methods is 0 parameters
- Mandatory: finalize methods not have 0 parameters

RuleName: MagicNumber
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [tokens] is [NUM_DOUBLE, NUM_FLOAT, NUM_INT, NUM_LONG]
And
Mandatory: [tokens] not have [NUM_DOUBLE] -> [NUM_FLOAT]

RuleName: AvoidEscapedUnicodeCharacters
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: Order of import groups is {{customImportOrderRules}}
- Mandatory: {{customImportOrderRules}} should not have an import group at the end of import groups

RuleName: AbbreviationAsWordInName
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [AbbreviationAsWordInName] is [AbbreviationAsWordInName]

RuleName: EmptyBlock
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [block] of {{tokens}} is [Brace]

RuleName: NoWhitespaceAfter
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: Order of [tokens] is [ARRAY_INIT, AT, INC, DEC, UNARY_MINUS, UNARY_PLUS, BNOT, LNOT, DOT, TYPECAST, ARRAY_DECLARATOR, INDEX_OP, LITERAL_SYNCHRONIZED, METHOD_REF]
- Mandatory: [tokens] should not have [ARRAY_INIT, AT, INC, DEC, UNARY_MINUS, UNARY_PLUS, BNOT, LNOT, DOT, ARRAY_DECLARATOR, INDEX_OP] at the end of [tokens]

RuleName: ConstantName
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [constant names] is [valid constant name pattern]

RuleName: AnnotationOnSameLine
Basic Rule:
- Order of [tokens] is {{tokens}} and {{tokens}} have [Brace]

RuleName: InterfaceMemberImpliedModifier
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [interface members] is {{InterfaceMemberImpliedModifier}}

RuleName: IllegalCatch
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [catch statement] is not [illegalClassNames]

RuleName: ModifiedControlVariable
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [for loop control variables] is not [modified inside the for block]

RuleName: FinalClass
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: Order of [class] is [final]
- Mandatory: [class] have [no declared constructors] -> [class] is [private]
- Mandatory: [class] have [only private constructors] -> [class] have [any modifier]

RuleName: IllegalThrows
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [throws] is {{IllegalThrows}}
And
Mandatory: {{IllegalThrows}} not have [java.lang.Error] -> [java.lang.Error]

RuleName: IllegalIdentifierName
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [IllegalIdentifierName] is [IllegalIdentifierName format]

RuleName: ParameterName
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [method parameters] is [specified pattern]

RuleName: SeparatorWrap
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [tokens] is [DOT, COMMA, SEMI, ELLIPSIS, AT, LPAREN, RPAREN, ARRAY_DECLARATOR, RBRACK, METHOD_REF]

RuleName: NewlineAtEndOfFile
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [file] is [NewlineAtEndOfFile]

RuleName: MutableException
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [members] is [final]

RuleName: ArrayTrailingComma
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [ArrayTrailingComma] is [ArrayTrailingComma]

RuleName: DeclarationOrder
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [class, record, or interface declaration parts] is [public class variables, protected, package level, private, public instance variables, protected, package level, private, constructors, methods]

RuleName: AvoidStarImport
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: Order of import groups is specified by customImportOrderRules.
- Mandatory: The customImportOrderRules should not have an import group at the end of import groups.

RuleName: JavadocMissingWhitespaceAfterAsterisk
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: Order of import groups is specified by customImportOrderRules
- Mandatory: The customImportOrderRules should not have an import group at the end of import groups

RuleName: StaticVariableName
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [StaticVariableName] is [format]

RuleName: Header
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: Order of [header] is [headerFile]

RuleName: RegexpOnFilename
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [fileExtensions] is String[]

RuleName: FileTabCharacter
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [FileTabCharacter] is not ['\t']

RuleName: EqualsAvoidNull
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [String literals] is [left side of an equals() comparison]
And
Mandatory: [String literals] not have [String literals] assigned to some field

RuleName: SuperClone
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [clone() method] is [super.clone()]

RuleName: WriteTag
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: Order of [Javadoc tag] is in the defined format
- Mandatory: [Javadoc comment] must have [Javadoc tag]

RuleName: CyclomaticComplexity
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [block] of {{tokens}} have [Brace]

RuleName: AnonInnerLength
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [lines] is [AnonInnerLength]

RuleName: OuterTypeFilename
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [OuterTypeFilename] is [Rulename]

RuleName: LocalVariableName
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [LocalVariableName] is [format]

RuleName: NestedTryDepth
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [try-catch-finally blocks] is [NestedTryDepth]

RuleName: MethodName
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: Order of [MethodName] is [format]
- Mandatory: [MethodName] not have [the same name as the residing class]

RuleName: GenericWhitespace
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: [Left angle bracket] is preceded with [whitespace] only in [generic methods definitions]
- Mandatory: [Left angle bracket] is not preceded with [whitespace] when it is preceded [method name] or [constructor]
- Mandatory: [Left angle bracket] is not preceded with [whitespace] when following [type name]
- Mandatory: [Left angle bracket] is not followed with [whitespace] in all cases
- Mandatory: [Right angle bracket] is not preceded with [whitespace] in all cases
- Mandatory: [Right angle bracket] is followed with [whitespace] in almost all cases, except [diamond operators] and when preceding a [method name], [constructor], or [record header]

RuleName: RightCurly
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [block] is [Brace]

RuleName: PackageName
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [package names] is [format for module PackageName]

RuleName: RequireThis
Basic Rule:
- Mandatory: Order of [references] is [this.varName] or [this.methodName(args)]
- Mandatory: [references] not rely on default behavior when [this.] is absent

RuleName: MultipleVariableDeclarations
Basic Rule:
Mandatory: Order of [variable declarations] is [one per line/statement]

Grammar:
RuleSet ::= Rule1 [And|Or|; Rule2]* # And means should satisfy Rule1 and Rule2. Or means can satisfy Rule1 or Rule2. ; means Rule1,Rule2 belongs to diffent groups
Rule ::= 'Optional:'| 'Mandatory:' [ ['Order' of | 'Number' of] TermList [Operator TermList]* | Rule1 '->' Rule2] [ExceptionRule] #'Order' of  means order rule, 'Number' of means numberConstraint, Rule1 '->' Rule2 means applying Rule2 under the premise of Rule1 
ExceptionRule ::= 'Except ' TermList | Rule # means rules not applied to TermList | Rule
Operator = 'is'| 'is not' | '>=' | '<=' | '=' | '!=' | 'for' | 'not for' | 'before' | 'not before' | 'after' | 'not after' | 'between' | 'not between' | 'have' | 'not have' | 'Add' | 'Sub' | 'Mult' | MatMult | 'Div' | 'Mod' | 'Pow' | 'LShift' | 'RShift' | 'BitOr' | 'BitXor' | 'BitAnd' | 'FloorDiv'
TermList ::= Term [, Term]*
Modifier ::= 'some' | 'each' | 'all' | 'except' | 'first' | 'last' | ...
Term :: = JavaTerm | Modifier* Term | Term of Term
JavaTerm means the formal expression using such format [XXX] "XXX" represent a JavaTerm


Response Format:
Mapping of RuleSet of Google Java Style Guide to Checkstyle:
first rule representation from RuleSet of Google Java Style Guide : if exists, only give corresponding RuleName of Checkstyle as a list. otherwise, gives None
second rule representation from RuleSet of Google Java Style Guide : ...
...

For Example, respond like:
Mapping of RuleSet of Google Java Style Guide to Checkstyle:
"Mandatory: [IfStatement], [ElseStatement], [ForStatement], [DoStatement], [WhileStatement] have [Brace]" : ["NeedBraces"]
"Mandatory: [body] of [IfStatement], [ElseStatement], [ForStatement], [DoStatement], [WhileStatement] is [Null] —> [IfStatement], [ElseStatement], [ForStatement], [DoStatement], [WhileStatement] have [Brace]" : []
"Mandatory: [Number] of [body] of [IfStatement], [ElseStatement], [ForStatement], [DoStatement], [WhileStatement] = 1 —> [IfStatement], [ElseStatement], [ForStatement], [DoStatement], [WhileStatement] have [Brace]" : []

Mapping of RuleSet of Google Java Style Guide to Checkstyle:
"Mandatory: [Source files] are [encoded] in [UTF-8]" : None
